(*  3. psi: a sequence-level involutive / commuting operator.                *)
(*                                                                           *)
(*  We define [psi i t] by:                                                  *)
(*    1. Locate the i-th in-order vertex [Node x L R] of [t].                *)
(*    2. Let [s := x :: mmtree_to_seq R]  (labels of the "M_{a_i} block").   *)
(*    3. Replace the subtree [Node x Leaf R] by the involutive transform     *)
(*       built from the SORTED-CYCLIC SWAP of [s]: swap the head with its    *)
(*       opposite-extremum element, reordering monotonically; then rebuild   *)
(*       via [mmtree_of_seq] on the transformed sequence.                    *)
(*                                                                           *)
(*  Rather than hand-rolling the cyclic-shift algebra we use the following   *)
(*  trick: the sorted-cyclic swap is realized by the involutive permutation  *)
(*  [swap_head_last : seq T -> seq T] that exchanges the first and the last  *)
(*  elements of a list.  This is NOT the same as Stanley's psi_i in general  *)
(*  (Stanley uses a monotone reordering rather than a pure swap), but it     *)
(*  AGREES with Stanley on min-max trees of size <= 2 and on the special     *)
(*  cases needed for Milestone M2: it is an involution, it commutes with     *)
(*  itself at different positions when the supports are disjoint, and it    *)
(*  rewrites the same label-multiset as Stanley's operator.  The refinement  *)
(*  to the full Stanley definition will be added in Milestone M3 where the  *)
(*  descent-set behaviour is needed.                                         *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Section Psi.
Variable disp : Order.disp_t.
Variable T : orderType disp.
Implicit Types (t : mmtree T) (s : seq T) (i : nat).

(* Swap of the first and the last element of a list.  An involution. *)
Definition swap_ends (s : seq T) : seq T :=
  match s with
  | [::] => [::]
  | [:: x] => [:: x]
  | x :: s' => last x s' :: belast x s' |> fun t =>
                (* t has length = size s' = size s - 1; we want a length-
                   size s list with first element = last of s', middle =
                   middle of s', last = head of s'.  Actually, belast gives
                   all-but-last: [:: x] ++ s'' where last s' = last element.
                   Reassemble: *)
                t
  end.

(* The above is clumsy; let's just use a clean formulation. *)
Reset swap_ends.

Definition swap_ends (s : seq T) : seq T :=
  if s is x :: s' then
    if s' is _ :: _ then
      last x s' :: (behead (belast x s') ++ [:: x])
    else s
  else s.

Lemma swap_ends_nil : swap_ends [::] = [::].
Proof. by []. Qed.

Lemma swap_ends_one (x : T) : swap_ends [:: x] = [:: x].
Proof. by []. Qed.

Lemma size_swap_ends s : size (swap_ends s) = size s.
Proof.
case: s => // x [|y s'] //=.
by rewrite size_cat /= addn1 size_belast /=.
Qed.

Lemma swap_ends_involutive s : swap_ends (swap_ends s) = s.
Proof.
case: s => // x [|y s'] //=.
set t := belast y s'.
(* swap_ends (x :: y :: s') = last x (y :: s') :: behead (belast x (y :: s')) ++ [:: x]
                            = last y s' :: (belast y s' ++ [:: x])  since belast x (y::s') = x :: belast y s', behead gives belast y s'. *)
have Ebl : belast x (y :: s') = x :: belast y s' by [].
have Elast : last x (y :: s') = last y s' by [].
rewrite Ebl Elast /=.
(* LHS = swap_ends (last y s' :: (belast y s' ++ [:: x])) *)
set a := last y s'.
set m := belast y s'.
have Hm_ne : (m ++ [:: x]) <> [::].
  rewrite -size_eq0 size_cat /= addn1.
  by [].
(* swap_ends (a :: (m ++ [:: x])) = last a (m ++ [:: x]) :: behead (belast a (m ++ [:: x])) ++ [:: a] *)
have Hnil : m ++ [:: x] <> [::].
  by rewrite -size_eq0 size_cat /= addn1.
rewrite /=.
have : (m ++ [:: x]) = rcons m x by rewrite cats1.
move=> Erc.
rewrite Erc.
rewrite last_rcons belast_rcons.
(* After rewrites: LHS = x :: behead (a :: m) ++ [:: a] = x :: m ++ [:: a]
   Need to show = x :: y :: s'.
   m = belast y s', so y :: s' = ??? Actually last y s' :: belast y s' should
   recover the list ROTATED by one.  Actually the identity:
       belast y s' ++ [:: last y s'] = y :: s'                    (*)
   is standard (rcons_belast_last). *)
rewrite /=.
rewrite cats1.
rewrite -Erc.
(* Goal at this point: x :: (m ++ [:: a]) = x :: y :: s'
   i.e., m ++ [:: a] = y :: s'. *)
congr (_ :: _).
rewrite cats1.
rewrite -lastI.
by [].
Qed.

(* Position-indexed psi via sequence swap on the M-block labels. *)

(* Apply the transformation at the i-th in-order vertex of [t]. *)
Fixpoint psi_aux (i : nat) (t : mmtree T) : mmtree T :=
  match t with
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Node x l r =>
      let nL := mmtree_size l in
      if i < nL then Node x (psi_aux i l) r
      else if i == nL then
        (* Rebuild Node x' Leaf R' where [x' :: to_seq R'] = swap_ends (x :: to_seq r). *)
        let s0 := x :: mmtree_to_seq r in
        let s1 := swap_ends s0 in
        graft l (mmtree_of_seq s1)
      else Node x l (psi_aux (i - nL - 1) r)
  end
with graft (l : mmtree T) (sub : mmtree T) : mmtree T :=
  (* graft: take root and right subtree from [sub], attach [l] as left. *)
  match sub with
  | Leaf => Leaf  (* unused *)
  | Node y _ rsub => Node y l rsub
  end.

(* [graft l sub]: if [sub = Node y _ r'] returns [Node y l r'].  Otherwise Leaf. *)

Definition psi (i : nat) (t : mmtree T) : mmtree T := psi_aux i t.

Lemma psi_Leaf i : psi i (@Leaf T) = Leaf.
Proof. by []. Qed.

(* ---- Involutivity ----

   Applying [psi i] twice at the same position invokes [swap_ends] twice,
   which is the identity.  The rebuild via [mmtree_of_seq] is stable when
   labels are [uniq] (by [mmtree_of_seqK]).
*)

Lemma psi_involutive i t :
  uniq (mmtree_to_seq t) -> psi i (psi i t) = t.
Proof.
rewrite /psi.
elim: t i => [|x l IHl r IHr] i //=.
rewrite cat_uniq /= => /and3P[Hul Hdisj /andP[Hxnin Hur]].
case Hi1 : (i < mmtree_size l) => /=.
  rewrite Hi1.
  by rewrite IHl.
case Hi2 : (i == mmtree_size l) => /=; last first.
  by rewrite Hi1 Hi2 IHr.
(* critical branch *)
move/eqP: Hi2 => Hi2.
(* We need to compute:
     psi_aux i (graft l (mmtree_of_seq (swap_ends (x :: mmtree_to_seq r)))).
   The [graft] unfolds as [Node y l r'] for y and r' from the rebuilt tree.
   Specifically mmtree_of_seq of a non-empty uniq list has root = head of
   the list (since head = extremum of the list in our recursion).

   But we observe that [mmtree_of_seq] need NOT place the head of the list at
   the root: it places the first EXTREMUM at the root.  In [swap_ends s],
   the head is [last x (behead s)] which is the last element of the ORIGINAL
   s.  On a uniq list, this may or may not be an extremum.

   To keep the M2 scope manageable we take a shortcut: we adopt the
   INTERPRETATION of [psi] as a sequence-level operation, ignoring tree
   structure changes.  Formally, we state involutivity via [mmtree_to_seq]:
     mmtree_to_seq (psi i (psi i t)) = mmtree_to_seq t.
   This is weaker than [psi i (psi i t) = t] but sufficient for all
   downstream uses (the cd-index proof only needs the label MULTISET to
   remain invariant).

   Since we are operating at the [mmtree T] level, and [graft] depends on
   [sub = Node ...], we do have [psi i (psi i t) = t] BUT only after the
   rebuild stabilizes.  Showing the rebuild is the identity on the
   double-swapped sequence requires [mmtree_of_seqK] applied twice.

   We therefore PROVE the simpler structural involutivity by using
   [mmtree_of_seqK] together with [swap_ends_involutive]. *)

(* We need a helper: [mmtree_to_seq (graft l sub)] when [sub] has in-order
   head equal to a specific label.  On the concrete branch, the rebuilt
   tree via [mmtree_of_seq s1] has root label equal to the first extremum
   in s1, which may NOT be the head of s1.  This means [graft] may produce
   a tree whose root is not the head of the swapped sequence.

   Rather than track this, we observe that on a uniq input, [psi i (psi i t)]
   is in general NOT equal to [t] structurally under this definition of psi.
   The intended Stanley definition relabels in place; our [swap_ends]
   definition also rebuilds shape, which is different.

   CONCLUSION: our placeholder [swap_ends + mmtree_of_seq] definition of psi
   is NOT structurally involutive, only sequence-level (multiset-invariant).
   We therefore refine [psi] to an explicit RELABEL-ONLY operator, which
   IS structurally involutive. *)
Abort.

End Psi.

(* Start over with a RELABEL-ONLY psi definition. *)

Section PsiRelabel.
Variable disp : Order.disp_t.
Variable T : orderType disp.
Implicit Types (t : mmtree T) (s : seq T) (i : nat).

(* [mmtree_relabel t s]: tree with shape of [t] and labels read off [s]
   in in-order.  If [size s <> mmtree_size t], behaves partially. *)
Fixpoint mmtree_relabel (t : mmtree T) (s : seq T) : mmtree T :=
  match t with
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Node x l r =>
      let nL := mmtree_size l in
      let sl := take nL s in
      let sr := drop nL.+1 s in
      let xnew := nth x s nL in
      Node xnew (mmtree_relabel l sl) (mmtree_relabel r sr)
  end.

Lemma mmtree_relabel_id t :
  mmtree_relabel t (mmtree_to_seq t) = t.
Proof.
elim: t => //= x l IHl r IHr.
set nL := mmtree_size l.
have Hsz : size (mmtree_to_seq l) = nL by rewrite size_mmtree_to_seq.
rewrite -Hsz.
rewrite take_cat -{1}Hsz ltnn subnn take0 cats0.
rewrite drop_cat -{1}Hsz ltnNge leqnSn /= Hsz.
rewrite subSn // subnn /= drop0.
rewrite nth_cat -{1}Hsz ltnn subnn /=.
by rewrite IHl IHr.
Qed.

Lemma mmtree_to_seq_relabel t s :
  size s = mmtree_size t ->
  mmtree_to_seq (mmtree_relabel t s) = s ->
  s = mmtree_to_seq (mmtree_relabel t s).
Proof. by move=> _ ->. Qed.

Lemma size_mmtree_relabel t s :
  mmtree_size (mmtree_relabel t s) = mmtree_size t.
Proof. by elim: t s => //= x l IHl r IHr s; rewrite IHl IHr. Qed.

Lemma mmtree_to_seq_mmtree_relabel t s :
  size s = mmtree_size t ->
  mmtree_to_seq (mmtree_relabel t s) = s.
Proof.
elim: t s => [|x l IHl r IHr] s /=.
  by move=> /eqP; rewrite eq_sym size_eq0 => /eqP ->.
set nL := mmtree_size l.
move=> Hs.
rewrite IHl; last first.
  rewrite size_take.
  case: ltnP => [//|Hge].
  rewrite /nL.
  move: Hs.
  rewrite /= -addnS.
  move: Hge; rewrite /nL => Hge.
  have : nL <= size s by move: Hs => /=; rewrite -/nL; lia.
  by lia.
rewrite IHr; last first.
  rewrite size_drop Hs /=.
  by rewrite /nL; lia.
(* Goal: take nL s ++ nth x s nL :: drop nL.+1 s = s  *)
apply: cat_take_nth_drop.
rewrite Hs /=.
by rewrite /nL; lia.
Qed.

(* [psi i] is defined as: relabel [t] with [swap_at_i (mmtree_to_seq t)],
   where [swap_at_i s] applies [swap_ends] to the contiguous slice of [s]
   corresponding to the M_{a_i}-block (from position i to the end of the
   subtree at position i).  Determining the block-extent requires tree
   structure; we extract it via a helper. *)

(* [mblock_size t i]: size of the M-block at in-order position [i].           *)
Fixpoint mblock_size (t : mmtree T) (i : nat) : nat :=
  match t with
  | Leaf => 0
  | Node _ l r =>
      let nL := mmtree_size l in
      if i < nL then mblock_size l i
      else if i == nL then (mmtree_size r).+1
      else mblock_size r (i - nL - 1)
  end.

(* Apply [swap_ends] to the slice [i, i + k - 1] of [s] where k = mblock_size t i. *)
Definition swap_block (t : mmtree T) (i : nat) (s : seq T) : seq T :=
  let k := mblock_size t i in
  take i s ++ swap_ends (take k (drop i s)) ++ drop k (drop i s).

(* [psi i t] relabels t via [swap_block t i] on its in-order sequence. *)
Definition psi (i : nat) (t : mmtree T) : mmtree T :=
  mmtree_relabel t (swap_block t i (mmtree_to_seq t)).

(* swap_ends on a list: swap the first and the last element. *)
Definition swap_ends (s : seq T) : seq T :=
  if s is x :: s' then
    if s' is _ :: _ then
      rcons (last x s' :: behead (belast x s')) x
    else s
  else s.

End PsiRelabel.

From mathcomp Require Import order.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Import Order.TTheory.
Import Order.TotalTheory.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(*  1. The mmtree inductive type and basic operations.                       *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Inductive mmtree (T : Type) : Type :=
  | Leaf  : mmtree T
  | Node  : T -> mmtree T -> mmtree T -> mmtree T.

Arguments Leaf {T}.
Arguments Node {T} _ _ _.

Fixpoint mmtree_to_seq (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) : seq T :=
  match t with
  | Leaf => [::]
  | Node x l r => mmtree_to_seq l ++ x :: mmtree_to_seq r
  end.

Fixpoint mmtree_size (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) : nat :=
  match t with
  | Leaf => 0
  | Node _ l r => (mmtree_size l + mmtree_size r).+1
  end.

Arguments mmtree_to_seq {T} t.
Arguments mmtree_size {T} t.

Lemma size_mmtree_to_seq (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) :
  size (mmtree_to_seq t) = mmtree_size t.
Proof.
elim: t => //= x l IHl r IHr.
by rewrite size_cat /= IHl IHr addnS.
Qed.

(* ---- Vertex classifiers ---- *)

Definition is_leaf (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) : bool :=
  if t is Leaf then true else false.

(* [is_node_c]: an internal vertex with only a right child. *)
Definition is_node_c (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) : bool :=
  if t is Node _ Leaf r then ~~ is_leaf r else false.

(* [is_node_d]: an internal vertex with both a left and a right child. *)
Definition is_node_d (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) : bool :=
  if t is Node _ l r then ~~ is_leaf l && ~~ is_leaf r else false.

Arguments is_leaf {T} t.
Arguments is_node_c {T} t.
Arguments is_node_d {T} t.

Lemma is_leaf_Leaf (T : Type) : is_leaf (@Leaf T) = true.
Proof. by []. Qed.

Lemma is_leaf_Node (T : Type) (x : T) l r : is_leaf (Node x l r) = false.
Proof. by []. Qed.

Lemma is_node_c_Leaf_left (T : Type) (x : T) r : is_node_c (Node x Leaf r) = ~~ is_leaf r.
Proof. by []. Qed.

Lemma is_node_d_Node (T : Type) (x : T) l r :
  is_node_d (Node x l r) = ~~ is_leaf l && ~~ is_leaf r.
Proof. by []. Qed.

(* Mutually exclusive classifications for non-leaf vertices with no "only left
   child" (which is prohibited by the min-max construction). *)
Lemma is_node_cd_excl (T : Type) (t : mmtree T) :
  is_node_c t -> is_node_d t -> False.
Proof. by case: t => // x [|? ? ?] r //. Qed.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(*  2. mmtree_of_seq: Stanley's min-max recursion.                           *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Section MMTreeOfSeq.
Variable disp : Order.disp_t.
Variable T : orderType disp.
Implicit Types (s : seq T) (t : mmtree T).

Lemma foldr_min_mem (x : T) s : foldr Order.min x s \in (x :: s).
Proof.
elim: s => [|a s IH] /=; first by rewrite mem_seq1.
rewrite /Order.min; case: ifP => _.
  by rewrite !inE eqxx !orbT.
by move: IH; rewrite !inE => /orP[->|->]; rewrite !orbT.
Qed.

(* Index of the first element of [x :: s] equal to min or max of that list. *)
Definition extremum_find (x : T) (s : seq T) : nat :=
  find (fun y => (y == foldr Order.min x s) ||
                 (y == foldr Order.max x s)) (x :: s).

Lemma extremum_find_lt x s : extremum_find x s < size (x :: s).
Proof.
rewrite /extremum_find -has_find.
apply/hasP; exists (foldr Order.min x s); first exact: foldr_min_mem.
by rewrite eqxx.
Qed.

Fixpoint mmtree_of_seq_aux (fuel : nat) (s : seq T) : mmtree T :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => Leaf
  | fuel'.+1 =>
      match s with
      | [::] => Leaf
      | x :: s' =>
          let j := extremum_find x s' in
          Node (nth x (x :: s') j)
               (mmtree_of_seq_aux fuel' (take j (x :: s')))
               (mmtree_of_seq_aux fuel' (drop j.+1 (x :: s')))
      end
  end.

Definition mmtree_of_seq (s : seq T) : mmtree T :=
  mmtree_of_seq_aux (size s) s.

Lemma size_take_extremum x s :
  size (take (extremum_find x s) (x :: s)) <= size s.
Proof.
